scope_choices: This is automated model review, not independent human verification, replication, or clinical validation.
The synthesis read all supplied text and all supplied page/image review notes. Direct images were available to earlier documented page-review calls, not to this synthesis call.
The source hash, path, availability, and page count come from the supplied source record. PDF bytes and filesystem identity were not independently checked.
No cited full texts, external publisher metadata, repositories, code, or supplements were retrieved. Supplement availability remains not_assessed.

Inapplicability assertions are explicitly scoped to the review's own non-operational contribution and dependencies requiring a model, pipeline, action interface, or evaluation run. They do not classify cited systems or deny that relevant methods are discussed.

Paper-level uncertainty, causal-interpretation, safety, intended-use, regulatory-mention, and release-reporting gaps remain not_reported where the discussion does not establish the operational criteria. No missingness disposition is treated as a failed test.
The review's claims of comprehensiveness and balance are not supported by a reported reproducible search, screening, or quality-appraisal protocol.

Table 1 and Section 5.7 disagree about reference 145. The table marks FS and ODEs, with PE and PDEs dashed; the prose describes PDE modeling and parameter estimation. Neither statement was silently corrected.
Table 1's dashes have no explicit epistemic legend. They are not independently verified absence findings about the cited studies.

The drug-response discussion attributes PK/PD, dosing, and efficacy benefits to references 134–135. Their listed titles do not independently substantiate these specific claims or establish PINN implementation.
Physics-loss penalties do not alone establish exact conservation, physical consistency, interpretability, causal intervention validity, hard safety guards, or clinical safety.
Generic RNN recurrence, coordinate-to-solution approximation, inverse estimation, and time-stepping exposition are not an implemented health-world transition belonging to this article.

Patient time, physical-equation time, layer indices, training iterations, training-set size, and forecast horizons remain distinct. Figure 2's epsilon is not a clinical tolerance or validated horizon.

Parameter calibration, Bayesian posterior approximation, uncertainty existence, uncertainty decomposition, predictive calibration evaluation, and acceptance are separate. No original predictive coverage or reliability result is reported.

Potential equation issues remain unresolved: graph-spectral notation in Equation 13; GAN prior/data terminology around Equation 21; changing target/prediction notation; and possible self-coupling in Equation 29.
The linearized Bayes formula loses fraction formatting. Earlier image-review notes identify a correctly typeset denominator; this is not coded as a demonstrated mathematical error.
Article CC BY licensing does not establish code, weights, or model licensing. Consent and data-availability declarations do not establish regulatory authorization.
Historical audit identities, dates, quotation-match counts, and completion statements in raw legacy cells are preserved but were not reproduced.
No executable schema validator, semantic validator, graph rebuild, file write, or canonical admission was performed by this synthesis.
